shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md

cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup Switch useThemeValue useTheme 2>&1 | head -60; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -200

sed -n 200,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | grep -n -i -A20 "ThemeProvider" | head -80; grep -n -i -C4 "ThemeProvider\|system\|useTheme" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -120; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider SegmentedRadioGroup useThemeValue useTheme 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls build/esm/components/theme/; ls build/esm/components/controls 2>/dev/null; find build/esm -name "SegmentedRadioGroup*.d.ts" | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/useTheme.d.ts theme/useThemeValue.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; grep -n "theme\|Theme" ../index.d.ts index.d.ts | head; grep -rn "RadioGroupProps\b" --include=*.d.ts -l . | head -3
grep -n -A12 "interface ControlGroupProps" types.d.ts; grep -n "variant" Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; ls ../../../build/esm/components/layout | head; grep -n "^export" layout/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/main.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\n\nimport { App } from './App';","import { App } from './App';\nimport { PersistedThemeProvider } from './theme/PersistedThemeProvider';")
s=s.replace('<ThemeProvider theme="light">','<PersistedThemeProvider>').replace('</ThemeProvider>','</PersistedThemeProvider>')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat src/main.tsx; grep -n "secondary" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/text/colorText/colorText.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -5

grep -rn "'secondary'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/ -r --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -rln "secondary" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/text/ 2>/dev/null | head; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -3
